decisive_items: A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules located on the face and vulva
Family history was notable for a daughter with similar facial papules
response.rationale: R2 directly names the syndrome matching the SUFU mutation and clinical findings; R1 is an equivalent synonym but includes a contradictory note about absent palmar pits, making R2 more precise.

rejected.why: Synonym of R2; contradicted by 'No palmar or plantar pits were observed' which is not required for diagnosis but weakens specificity.
